title: Planned change: the Summary drill-down keeps the as-of date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X had a past-due invoice on the 1st of last month.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to the 1st of last month.
  4. Click customer X's name.
  5. Read the page title.
  6. Read the date chip.
  7. Read the Customer chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

  • Step 5 (unchanged from before the release): A/R Aging Collection is open.

Step 6:

  • PRD v12, S5-R11, quoted: “Clicking a customer or vendor on A/R Summary or A/P Summary opens A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices with just that customer or vendor ticked, the same as-of date, the same ticked Past due ranges and the same ticked locations.”
  • Step 6 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The date chip shows the 1st of last month (production opened on today's date).
  • Step 7 (unchanged from before the release): The Customer chip names customer X.
  • Related existing case: S5-26 C715400 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715400); S5-27 C715401 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715401). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: A collector drilling into a past month must stay in that month.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S5-R11. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:332-335; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingSummaryReport.vue:310-313; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:330-337.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S5-R11, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-060). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
